recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. Follow up in the FHIR Extension Pack by adding or restoring a standard Address logical identifier extension, unless MnM/FHIR-I confirms the existing extension set intentionally supersedes FHIR-28950.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue asking for logical identifiers for Address, with final resolution to create a standard extension for Address carrying Identifier rather than adding Address.identifier to the base datatype.
initial_application: Commit 732b40c16876bd7f23e75b50253824d920485f4e added an identifier row to source/datatypes/address-extensions-spreadsheet.xml for Address with value type Identifier and definition text about address geocode or postal identity identifiers. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 later removed that row as part of removing extensions from R5 source before the R5 publication tag.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini currently lists several datatype extension spreadsheets but no active address-extensions profile entry. The FHIR Extension Pack is the current home for datatype extension definitions and has Address-context extensions, but no Address-level identifier extension matching this Jira resolution. A December 2021 Zulip thread noticed the Applied status and missing described R5 Address identifier change, with no later superseding Jira or community decision found.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source files were edited because re-adding an Address extension to inactive core source would not affect the current build; the actionable source change belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack or requires explicit WG confirmation that the decision has been superseded.
